evals.prompt: 上传一张浅蓝色模具布丁照片，顶部有白色奶油和红色樱桃，做成这个极简小人海报。
evals.expected_output: The result preserves a molded blue pudding and does not reinterpret it as shaved ice, cake, jelly mountain, or another dessert.
expectations: Subject category remains pudding.
Molded fluted silhouette remains recognizable.
Blue smooth/glossy pudding material is preserved.
White cream and red cherry are preserved when visible in the source.
Background clutter is simplified without changing the hero object.

evals.prompt: 小人要极简一点，不要设计成角色。
evals.expected_output: All micro workers follow one fixed primitive faceless figure system.
expectations: Workers have blank round or slightly lumpy heads.
No eyes, mouth, facial expression, hair, or hats appear.
No clothing details, uniforms, labels, logos, badges, or body symbols appear.
Black uneven single-line drawing is used.
Action is communicated through pose, tool, and contact rather than expression.

evals.prompt: 标题写‘清甜下午茶’，字体要像参考里那种稚拙、松散、细黑线手写。
evals.expected_output: The title uses thin black naive handwriting with irregular glyph skeletons rather than a standard font.
expectations: The exact requested phrase is used without extra copy.
Stroke appearance is thin black hand-line rather than heavy brush calligraphy.
Character sizes, tilt, spacing, and baselines are irregular.
Some horizontal strokes may be elongated.
The result avoids standard fonts, rounded cute handwriting, neat calligraphy, and polished commercial typography.

evals.prompt: 字体还是太像电脑字了，产品和构图已经满意，不要动其他地方。
evals.expected_output: The workflow selects Fidelity Mode with fidelity_focus=lettering and repairs only the lettering layer while preserving the accepted poster base.
expectations: The poster base remains unchanged.
fidelity_focus is lettering.
The failure is treated as a glyph-skeleton problem, not merely a texture problem.
Only the lettering layer is regenerated.
Glyph size, tilt, x/y position, spacing, radical proportions, and horizontal stroke length are varied.
The workflow does not recommend rerunning the whole poster as the primary fix.

evals.prompt: 主体是冰镇西瓜，做 4 到 5 个小人在上面工作。
evals.expected_output: Every worker action maps to a watermelon feature and no worker exists merely as decoration.
expectations: Hydration may map to hose/watering behavior.
Seeds may map to carrying/transport behavior.
Sweetness or ripeness may map to inspection behavior.
Eating may map to spoon/scooping behavior.
Cooling/rest may map to shade or cooling behavior when compositionally useful.
Random waving, balloons, or unrelated decorative activity is rejected.

evals.prompt: 这张照片背景里还有书、餐具和其他甜品，只要把前面的主甜品做成海报。
evals.expected_output: The chosen photographic hero is isolated and preserved while unrelated environmental clutter is removed or simplified.
expectations: Only the identified hero object is treated as the main subject.
Unrelated books, dishes, background desserts, and room details are removed or heavily simplified.
The product's defining plate/container may be kept if it aids recognition.
The final poster restores strong white negative space.

evals.prompt: 按照主体本身颜色做，不要乱加颜色。
evals.expected_output: The final palette uses source-derived product colors plus white background and black doodles only.
expectations: No unrelated decorative accent colors are introduced.
Doodles remain black.
Background remains white or very lightly warm white.
Source product colors remain faithful.

evals.prompt: 用 Fidelity Mode 做这张蔬菜农场照片，强调画面中最大的元素。
evals.expected_output: The workflow selects fidelity_focus=dominant_element and makes the giant red tomato the first photographic signal while retaining only minimal scene cues.
expectations: fidelity_focus is dominant_element.
The giant red tomato is explicitly identified as the focus element.
The tomato becomes the first visual signal at thumbnail size.
The tomato remains photographic with realistic red surface and green stem.
At most two secondary photographic scene cues remain prominent.
Workers interact with the tomato before secondary elements.
White space remains generous rather than recreating the whole installation.

evals.prompt: Fidelity Mode 强调最大的元素，但照片里墙面和桌子占的面积也很大。
evals.expected_output: The workflow chooses the largest meaningful subject element rather than literal background architecture or surface area.
expectations: The skill does not select a wall, ceiling, table, floor, curtain, or other irrelevant background as the focus merely because it occupies more pixels.
The focus is chosen from semantically meaningful subject elements.
The focus reason is stated as size, shape, color, or semantic importance.
Secondary background architecture is simplified or removed.

evals.prompt: 这张复杂展陈照片里我还是希望保留一点原场景感觉，但 Fidelity 要突出最大的红番茄。
evals.expected_output: The workflow uses Subject Lock + Scene Lock + Focus Lock without giving equal visual priority to every source object.
expectations: Subject Lock preserves the chosen real object identity.
Scene Lock keeps only one to three recognition cues from the original scene.
Focus Lock makes the giant tomato visually dominant.
Scene cues remain clearly secondary in scale and contrast.
The final poster does not become a white-background copy of every source object.

evals.prompt: 我给你三张照片，分别用 Fidelity Mode 做三张独立海报。
evals.expected_output: The workflow treats the three inputs as three independent generation cases and does not intentionally combine them into one collage or comparison image.
expectations: Each source image is processed as its own case.
The result target is three separate posters.
A combined comparison board is produced only if the user explicitly requests one.
Cross-image objects do not leak into another case's poster concept.
